name: Extended Embedded Languages Dev
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y make && npm install -g @vscode/vsce && cd utilities && npm install && cd .. && if curl -fsSL "https://github.com/emergy/extended-embedded-languages/releases/latest/download/extended-embedded-languages.vsix" -o /tmp/extended-embedded-languages.vsix; then code --install-extension /tmp/extended-embedded-languages.vsix; else echo "No public release asset found yet, skipping VSIX install"; fi
